def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    lines = [("row", r) for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])]
    lines += [("col", c) for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    axis, line = lines[0]
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != 2]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if axis == "row":
        lo, hi = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
        dr = line + 1 - lo if lo > line else line - 1 - hi
        moved = [(r + dr, c) for r, c in pts]
        stripe = (max(r for r, c in moved) + 1) if lo > line else (min(r for r, c in moved) - 1)
    else:
        lo, hi = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
        dc = line + 1 - lo if lo > line else line - 1 - hi
        moved = [(r, c + dc) for r, c in pts]
        stripe = (max(c for r, c in moved) + 1) if lo > line else (min(c for r, c in moved) - 1)
    for r, c in pts:
        out[r][c] = bg
    for r, c in moved:
        out[r][c] = grid[r - (dr if axis == "row" else 0)][c - (dc if axis == "col" else 0)]
    if axis == "row" and 0 <= stripe < h:
        out[stripe] = [8] * w
    elif axis == "col" and 0 <= stripe < w:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][stripe] = 8
    return out
